description.before:
Based on the official CHED PSG (CMO No. 37, s. 2017), the Bachelor of Arts in Broadcasting program is designed to develop competent and ethical broadcast practitioners and communication professionals. The program provides students with a strong theoretical foundation in communication theories, media laws and ethics, and the social responsibilities of broadcasters.
It integrates theory with practical skills in broadcast writing, production, and management across various platforms, including radio, television, and new media. The curriculum equips students with the knowledge of broadcasting principles, the ability to produce content for diverse audiences, and the skills to manage broadcast operations. Students are trained to become critical thinkers, effective communicators, and responsible media professionals who can contribute to the development of the Philippine media landscape.
description.after: Students in this program study Broadcasting and its practical applications. They strengthen broadcast writing and production, technical proficiency, communication and presentation. The program supports entry-level roles such as Broadcast Journalist and Broadcast Reporter.

courses.course_name: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration major in Financial Management

description.before:

The program aims to develop competent, ethical, and socially responsible business professionals who can effectively manage organizations in a dynamic and globalized environment.
The Financial Management major focuses on the effective management of financial resources within organizations. Students learn to analyze financial data, make investment decisions, manage risks, and develop strategies to maximize shareholder value. The curriculum covers key areas such as financial analysis, capital budgeting, portfolio management, working capital management, and financial markets and institutions. Graduates are prepared for careers in corporate finance, investment banking, financial planning, and related fields.
description.after: An undergraduate program centered on Business Administration major in Financial Management. Key learning areas include financial analysis and decision-making, quantitative and analytical skills, strategic financial management. courses.course_name: Bachelor of Science in Ceramics Engineering

description.before:
Based on the official CHED PSG (CMO No. 90, s. 2017), the Bachelor of Science in Ceramics Engineering (also referred to as Ceramic Engineering) program is designed to produce graduates who can apply engineering principles to the processing, production, and utilization of ceramic materials. The program covers the fundamental science and engineering of ceramics, including the structure, properties, processing, and applications of ceramic materials.
Ceramics Engineering deals with inorganic, non-metallic materials. Students learn about the extraction and processing of raw materials, the design and operation of furnaces and kilns, and the development of ceramic products for various industries, including construction, electronics, aerospace, and biomedical applications. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical understanding and practical skills in materials characterization, process optimization, and quality control.
description.after: Students in this program study Ceramics Engineering and its practical applications. They strengthen materials science and engineering, process engineering, materials characterization. The program supports entry-level roles such as Ceramic Engineer and Materials Engineer.

courses.course_name: Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering

description.before:
Based on the official CHED PSG (CMO No. 91, s. 2017), the Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering program is designed to produce graduates who can apply the principles of chemistry, physics, mathematics, and engineering to design, develop, and operate processes and equipment for the production of chemicals, fuels, materials, and other products. Chemical engineers are involved in the conversion of raw materials into useful products through chemical and physical transformations.
The program covers fundamental areas such as thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat and mass transfer, reaction kinetics, process design, and process control. Students learn to analyze and solve problems related to chemical processes, including environmental and safety considerations. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical understanding and practical skills through laboratory work, design projects, and industrial training. Graduates are prepared for careers in various industries, including petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, food processing, energy, and environmental management.
description.after: An undergraduate program centered on Chemical Engineering. Key learning areas include process engineering, thermodynamics and transport phenomena, reaction engineering. It prepares students for entry-level work in fields such as Chemical Engineer and Process Engineer.

courses.course_name: Bachelor of Science in Chemistry

description.before:
Based on the official CHED PSG (CMO No. 47, s. 2017), the Bachelor of Science in Chemistry program is designed to provide students with a comprehensive education in the fundamental principles and practices of chemistry. The program covers the five core disciplines of chemistry: inorganic, organic, analytical, physical, and biochemistry.
The BS Chemistry program is structured to produce graduates who can apply chemical principles to solve problems in various fields, including industry, research, and education. Students develop a strong foundation in chemical theory, laboratory skills, and analytical techniques. The curriculum includes extensive laboratory work, research projects, and professional exposure to prepare graduates for careers as professional chemists or for advanced studies in chemistry and related fields. The program also prepares students for the Chemistry Licensure Examinations.
description.after: This program introduces students to the principles and practices of Chemistry. Graduates can explore entry-level opportunities such as Analytical Chemist and Teaching assistants in colleges and universities (with further training, MS and PhD, for tenured positions).
